cohort: The study included 200 newborns delivered by either normal vaginal delivery or caesarean section.
finding: The study found that preterm babies and those born via emergency LSCS had significantly higher mean umbilical cord blood TSH levels compared to term babies and those born via elective LSCS or normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Babies born by emergency LSCS had the highest mean cord blood TSH (18.3 mIU/L), followed by normal vaginal delivery (8.1 mIU/L), and elective LSCS (6.4 mIU/L).
